blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundational vision models have become the de facto standard for many vision tasks due to their strong performance. However, they are notoriously opaque and remain hard to interpret. We present ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a one-time, label-free feature alignment approach that efficiently converts foundational vision models into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in replacement across several downstream tasks-amortizing the cost of interpretability. ALOE is robust across pre-training paradigms (supervised, self-supervised, vision-language) and can preserve teacher-level generalization with orders of magnitude less data than training from scratch. On classification, it strongly outperforms vanilla B-cosification (e.g., +10.5 p.p. top-1 on ImageNet for DINOv3 ViT-B/16), retains strong linear probing, k-NN, and zero-shot transfer competitive with foundational backbones (DINOv3, SigLIP2) across diverse downstream datasets. It also preserves spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, while yielding well-localized and highly human-interpretable explanations by design.
blocks.zh: 基础性愿景模型由于性能强而成为许多愿景任务的实际标准. 然而,它们臭名昭著地不透明,而且仍然难以解释。 我们提出ALOE(ALign Once to Explain),是一种一次性的,无标签的特征对接方法,它有效地将基础视觉模型转换为内在可解释的B-cos变体. 一旦对齐,B-COs主干线就被用作跨下游几个任务的倒置替代,以抵消可解释性的成本。 ALOE在培训前的范式(监督,自我监督,视觉语言)中都很强势,可以保留师生一级的通俗化,数量级数据从头到尾都不如培训. 在分类上,它强于香草B-编码(例如:为DINOv3 VIT-B/16在ImageNet上为+10.5p.top-1),保留了强线性检测,k-NN,并保持了与基础骨干(DINOv3,SigLIP2)的零发相竞争,跨越了不同的下游数据集. 它还保留了对密集预测有用的空间结构特征,同时通过设计得出了位置化和高度人性化的解释.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large-scale vision foundation models, including self-supervised encoders in the DINO family [ 12 , 55 , 72 ] and contrastive vision–language models such as CLIP [ 60 ] and SigLIP [ 80 , 76 ] , are powerful and versatile feature extractors that achieve state-of-the-art performance across a diverse set of downstream tasks. Trained on billions of images and image–text pairs, these models serve as general-purpose building blocks across various domains, from fine-grained recognition to medical imaging, often replacing their fully supervised, domain-specific counterparts [ 72 ] . However, their decision-making processes remain largely opaque, which hinders their use in sensitive and safety-critical applications. Post-hoc explanation methods aim to mitigate this issue, but can be noisy and not always faithful to the underlying model being explained [ 2 , 61 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型的视觉基础模型,包括DINO家族的自我监督编码器[12,55,72]和对比的视觉-语言模型,如CLIP[60]和SigLIP[80,76],都是强大而多功能的特征提取器,可以跨出一套多样的下游任务实现最先进的性能. 这些模型对数十亿个图像和图象成对进行了培训,作为跨越各个领域的通用构件,从精细的识别到医学成像,常常取代其完全监督的、针对具体领域的对应物[72]。 然而,它们的决策过程基本上仍然不透明,妨碍了它们在敏感和安全关键应用中的使用。 事后解释方法旨在缓解这一问题,但可能很吵,并不总是忠实于解释的基本模式[2,61,3].

blocks.en: An alternative line of work develops inherently interpretable architectures that yield model-faithful explanations by design. They introduce architectural constraints that lead to human-interpretable, faithful summaries of the model’s computations; examples include prototype-based models [ 17 , 24 , 51 ] , dynamic linear models [ 6 , 7 ] , and concept-bottleneck models [ 37 , 54 , 62 ] . A prominent example is the family of B-cos Networks [ 7 , 8 ] , which replace linear transforms with bias-free B-cos transforms that promote weight-input alignment to enhance interpretability and enable a faithful summary of the model’s decision. To avoid training these models from scratch, recent work proposed ‘B-cosification’ [ 4 ] , an approach that efficiently transforms existing models to their B-cos variants post-hoc at a fraction of the full training cost. However, despite strong gains on fully-supervised convolutional backbones and competitive results on a CLIP ResNet [ 32 ] backbone, the B-cosification recipe provides only modest improvements for Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 25 ] , sometimes failing to match the performance of training from scratch. Since most modern foundation models are ViT-based, this significantly limits its practical utility and broader adoption.
blocks.zh: 另一种工作思路是发展内在可解释的建筑,通过设计产生对模型忠实的解释。 它们引入了建筑限制,导致对模型的计算进行人可解释的,忠实的总结;例子包括原型模型[17,24,51],动态线性模型[6,7],和概念-瓶颈模型[37,54,62]. 一个突出的例子是B-cos Networks[7,8]的家族,该家族将线性变换为无偏倚的B-cos 变换,促进重量输入对接,以提高可解释性并能够忠实地总结模型的决定. 为了避免从零开始培训这些模型,最近的工作提出了 " B-编码 " [4],这种方法以全额培训费用的一小部分有效地将现有模型转换为其B-COs后变体。 然而,尽管在全监督的革命骨干上取得了巨大进展,在CLIP ResNet[32]骨干上也取得了竞争结果,B-cosification secretment只为Visual Transformers(ViTs)[25]提供了微小的改进,有时无法从零开始匹配培训的表现. 由于大多数现代的基础模型都是以ViT为基础的,这大大限制了它的实用性和更广泛的采用.

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose a scalable approach to efficiently transform existing foundation models into B-cos variants, that is practically useful for modern ViTs. Specifically, we explore feature-alignment methods for fine-grained matching
between a pre-trained foundational teacher and its B-cosified student without any labeled supervision. We conduct a comprehensive study of key design choices, including which features/layers to align, alignment losses, model scales, and alignment dataset sizes. Unlike [ 4 ] , our approach, ALOE ( AL ign O nce to E xplain) ( Fig. 4 ), is a general-purpose recipe that requires only a single alignment of the backbone irrespective of the pre-training paradigm, such as fully-supervised, self-supervised, or contrastive vision-language training. Once aligned, the backbone can be used as a drop-in replacement across downstream tasks, amortizing the cost of interpretability.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了一个可扩展的方法,以有效地将现有的基础模型转变为B-cos变体,这实际上对现代虚拟技术有用。 具体来说,我们探索了精细配对的特征调整方法
在未经任何标记的监管的情况下,在经过预先培训的基金会教师与其B类学生之间。 我们全面研究关键设计选择,包括哪些特征/层来对齐、对齐损失、模型尺度和对齐数据集大小。 与[4]不同的是,我们的方法,ALOE(AL ign O Cance to E xplain)(图4)是一种通用的食谱,无论培训前模式如何,只需要对骨干进行单一的调整,如完全监督的,自我监督的,或对比的视觉语言培训. 一旦对齐,骨干可以用作跨下游任务的倒置替代,摊还可解释性的成本.

blocks.en: Despite its simplicity, ALOE is surprisingly effective and highly data and compute efficient. For example, while training SigLIP2 [ 76 ] from scratch required ≈ \approx 10B images and ≈ \approx 12B alt-texts, ALOE B-cosifies such a model while maintaining its generalization with only a small unlabeled alignment set: even 150k YFCC15M images already keep the ImageNet top-1 gap below 0.50 p.p. ( Fig. 9 ), and the full 15M-image alignment set reaches 83.87 % 83.87\% vs. 84.21 % 84.21\% for the SigLIP2 teacher (see Fig. 1 ). This makes the one-time alignment overhead clearly preferable to full retraining for achieving interpretability. Moreover, ALOE consistently outperforms vanilla B-cosification [ 4 ] across pre-training paradigms, improving ImageNet-1k linear-probe accuracy by +8.82 to +10.50 p.p. for the SigLIP2 and DINOv3 ViT-B/16 models shown in Fig. 2 . Our models also deliver strong linear-probing and zero-shot performance across datasets, preserve spatially structured features useful for dense prediction, and provide faithful, well-localized explanations ( Fig. 1 ).

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: (1) We propose ALOE ( AL ign O nce to E xplain) , a universal, one-time, label-free feature-alignment approach that enables efficient transformation of foundational ViT backbones into inherently interpretable B-cos variants while preserving downstream utility. (2) We conduct a detailed study of the design choices and provide key insights into alignment targets (layer-wise vs. pooled; single vs. multi-layer), loss families (MSE, cosine, SigLIP, InfoNCE), model scales, and alignment dataset sizes.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Large-scale vision foundation models trained on billion-scale datasets are de facto backbones for transfer learning and zero-shot tasks. These include self-supervised ViT encoders in the DINO family [ 12 , 55 , 72 ] and contrastive vision–language encoders such as CLIP [ 60 ] and SigLIP/SigLIP2 [ 80 , 76 ] . Supervised ViTs pre-trained on large datasets (e.g., ImageNet21k/22k [ 39 ] or proprietary corpora) also serve as strong backbones for downstream usage [ 25 , 39 ] .
Such encoders are also used by large vision-language models and generative models together with a pre-trained LLM for multimodal understanding [ 44 , 21 ] .
In this work, we transform modern vision foundation models into an inherently interpretable B-cos backbone via a single alignment step, while preserving downstream utility.
blocks.zh:
接受过十亿级数据集培训的大规模愿景基础模型,是转让学习和零镜头任务的实际主干. 其中包括DINO家族中自行监督的ViT编码器[12,55,72]和对比视觉-语言编码器,如CLIP[60]和SigLIP/SigLIP2[80,76]. 监督 ViTs在大型数据集(例如:ImageNet21k/22k [39]或专有公司)上进行预训,也成为下游使用的强力骨干[25,39].
这种编码器还被大型视觉语言模型和基因模型以及经过预先培训的LLM用于多式理解[44,21].
在这项工作中,我们通过单一的对接步骤,将现代愿景基础模型转变为内在可解释的B-COs骨干,同时保留下游的效用.

blocks.en: Inherently interpretable models. To understand deep neural networks (DNNs), post-hoc attribution methods spanning gradient- [ 5 , 70 , 73 , 15 ] activation- [ 67 , 14 , 36 , 77 ] , and perturbation-based [ 59 ] methods have been typically used, with the resulting explanation maps summarizing input regions contributing to the model’s decision. In contrast, inherently interpretable architectures enforce structural constraints to give human-understandable, model-faithful summaries of the computation. These include prototype-based models [ 17 , 24 , 51 ] , dynamic-linear models [ 6 , 7 ] , and concept-bottleneck models [ 37 , 54 , 62 , 57 ] . B-cos networks [ 8 ] replace linear layers with bias-free B-cos transforms that promote weight–input alignment, producing faithful, well-localized explanations by design and have gained recent prominence [ 56 , 27 ] . The cost of training such models from scratch at foundation scale motivated B-cosification [ 4 ] , which transforms existing networks to B-cos variants post hoc. While B-cosification showed gains on supervised CNNs and for a CLIP ResNet model, the transformation recipe falls short in performance for ViTs, limiting applicability to foundation models. We therefore propose a scalable approach to transform ViT-based foundation backbones into inherently interpretable B-cos variants.
blocks.zh: 固有可解释模型. 为了了解深神经网络(DNNs),通常使用跨越梯度的后热归因方法 -- -- [5、70、73、15] 活化 -- -- [67、14、36、77] 和以扰动为基础的[59] 方法,由此产生的解释地图总结了输入区域,有助于模型的决定。 相形之下,内在可被诠释的建筑会强制实施结构上的限制,给人以可以理解的,有模型性的计算摘要. 其中包括以原型为基础的模型[17,24,51],动态线性模型[6,7],和概念-瓶颈模型[37,54,62,57]. B-cos网络 [8] 以无偏差的 B-cos 变换来促进重量-输入对齐,通过设计产生忠实,本地化的解释,并获得了近期的知名度 [56,27]. 从零开始培训这种模型的成本是促使B-编码[4],将现有的网络转换成B-cos的变体。 虽然B-编码显示在受监督的CNN和CLIP ResNet模型上有所收获,但ViTs的变换配方的性能不足,限制了对基础模型的适用性. 因此,我们提出一种可扩展的方法,将基于ViT的基础骨干转化为固有的可解释的B-COs变体。

blocks.en:
Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers behavior from a pre-trained model (‘teacher’ 𝒯 \mathcal{T} ) to a smaller model (‘student’ 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ) using soft targets or intermediate features, often for compression.
Logit-based KD [ 33 ] which aligns output distributions between 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} has been extended with feature-level and attention-based alignment objectives [ 79 , 64 , 58 ] , layer-wise and multi-stage schemes [ 82 ] , and token-level distillation for ViTs [ 75 ] . Recent works [ 56 ] also leverage explanation map similarity objectives which improve faithfulness over logit-only KD, and improve robustness under distribution shifts. To reduce reliance on annotations, label-free KD techniques use unlabeled or synthetic data [ 52 , 69 ] .
In contrast to compression as a goal, we use a one-time, label-free feature alignment objective—akin to KD—to convert a frozen vision foundation model into an inherently interpretable B-cos counterpart. Our universal recipe retains the teacher’s general-purpose features, provides model faithful explanations, and requires orders of magnitude fewer images than full billion-scale pre-training.
blocks.zh:
知识分馏(KD)将行为从预先训练的模型("老师"T\mathcal{T})转移到使用软目标或中间特性的更小的模型("学生"S\mathcal{S})上,通常用于压缩.
基于逻辑的 KD [33] 将 T\ mathcal{T} 和 S\ mathcal{S} 之间的输出分布相协调的 KD 已被扩展, 其特性级和关注级对齐目标 [79, 64, 58], 分层和多阶段方案 [82], 以及 Vits [75] 的符号级分馏 。 近期的作品 [56] 也利用了解释地图的相似性目标,这些目标提高了信得过只登录的KD,并在分配转移时提高了稳健性. 为了减少对说明的依赖,无标签的KD技术使用无标签或合成数据[52,69].
相对于压缩作为一个目标,我们使用一次性的无标签特性对接目标——类似于KD——来将被冻结的视觉基础模型转换为内在可被解释的B-cos对应物. 我们的通用食谱保留了教师的通用特征,提供了模范的忠实解释,并且需要比十亿份规模的预训更少的图像。

blocks.en: 3 Background: B-cos networks

blocks.en: In this section we briefly review B-cos networks [ 8 ] ( Sec. 3.1 ) and the B-cosification [ 4 ] ( Sec. 3.2 ) recipe proposed for CNNs, before presenting our approach ( Sec. 4 ).

B-cos networks [ 8 ] are inherently interpretable architectures that provide faithful and human-interpretable explanations of model decisions. Stacking such units builds a dynamic-linear network that produces an exact, faithful summary 𝐲 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) = 𝐖 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ​ 𝐱 \mathbf{y}(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{W}(\mathbf{x})\,\mathbf{x} , where 𝐖 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{W}(\mathbf{x}) is the effective input-dependent dynamic linear weight from the full model.
Increasing B > 1 B{>}1 promotes weight–input alignment, making 𝐖 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{W}(\mathbf{x}) more task-relevant and interpretable. The cosine term raised to the power of B − 1 B{-}1 provides the non-linearity needed for learning while preserving model expressivity.

blocks.en: 3.2 B-cosification recipe
blocks.zh: 3.2 B-编码配方

blocks.en: To alleviate the need to retrain B-cos variants of existing models, ‘B-cosification’ [ 4 ] was proposed as a means to transform a pre-trained conventional model into its B-cos variant by making targeted architectural modifications followed by supervised fine-tuning for few epochs on the original task. Broadly, the transformation involves replacing linear transforms with corresponding B-cos transforms ( Eq. 1 ) with B = 2 B=2 and removing biases from all layers including normalization layers. In contrast to the original B-cos architecture [ 8 ] , point-wise activation functions (ReLU/GELU) are left in and weights are not unit normalized, as it preserves the distribution of the learnt weights without harming interpretability. Following [ 8 ] , 3-channel image inputs given by ( r , g , b ) (r,g,b) are preprocessed to 6-channels ( r , g , b , 1 − r , 1 − g , 1 − b ) (r,g,b,1{-}r,1{-}g,1{-}b) to allow visualizing explanations in color, with a transform to the first layer weights to maintain equivalence.
blocks.zh: 为了缓解对现有模型的B-COs变体进行再培训的需要, " B-Cosification " [4] 被提议作为一种手段,将经过预先培训的常规模型转变为其B-COs变体,方法是进行有针对性的建筑改造,然后对最初任务的几个时代进行有监督的微调。 广义而言,这种转变涉及用相应的B-COs变换(Eq. 1)取而代之,取而代之的是B=2 B=2并去除包括正常化层在内的所有层的偏差. 与最初的B-COs架构[8]形成对比的是,点入活性函数(ReLU/GELU)被放入而重量不归正,因为它保持了所学重量的分布而不影响可解释性. 继 [8],由 (r, g, b) (r, g, b) 给出的3个通道的图像输入被预处理到6个通道(r, g, b, 1 - r, 1 - g, 1 - b) (r, g, b, 1{}r, 1{}, 1{} } 允许以颜色进行可视化解释,同时转换到第一层重来保持等效.

blocks.en: However, this recipe was designed with a focus on supervised CNNs, and was relatively ineffective for ViT-based architectures. In our work, we propose a scalable feature-alignment approach that is highly effective for modern ViT-based foundation models.

blocks.en: 4 ALOE: ALign Once to Explain
blocks.zh: 4 ALOE:一次解释

blocks.en:
In this section, we introduce ALOE ( AL ign O nce to E xplain) , a one-time, label-free feature-alignment procedure that converts a ViT-based foundation encoder into a B-cos [ 8 ] counterpart and aligns it to a frozen teacher via representation matching ( Fig. 4 ).
We first describe the teacher–student setup and the architecture-preserving transformation used to initialize the student ( Sec. 4.1 ). Next, we detail what is aligned and where in the network, including ViT-specific tokens (e.g., [CLS] and registers) and intermediate layers used to guide alignment ( Sec. 4.2 ). Finally, we describe our setup ( Sec. 4.3 ) and show how the aligned, inherently interpretable backbone can be used as a drop-in component across downstream tasks, thereby amortizing the cost of interpretability ( Sec. 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们引入了ALOE(AL ign Once to E xplain),这是一种一次性的,无标签的特征对接程序,将一个基于ViT的地基编码器转换为B-cos [8]对应器,并通过代表比对(图4)将其与被冻结的老师相配.
我们首先描述教师-学生的设置和用来初始化学生的建筑保留转变(第4.1节)。 接下来,我们详细列出网络中的对齐内容和位置,包括用于引导对齐的ViT特有标志(如[CLS]和注册)和中间层(第4.2条. 最后,我们描述我们的设置(第4.3节),并表明如何将经过调整的、内在可解释的骨干用作跨下游任务的下行部分,从而摊还可解释性的费用(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Label-free alignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 无标签对齐

blocks.en:
After conversion ( Sec. 4.1 ), we align the B-cos student 𝒮 \mathcal{S} to the frozen teacher 𝒯 \mathcal{T} using unlabeled images and a cosine-similarity objective.
Our aim is to make the aligned B-cos backbone a drop-in substitute for the foundation teacher. This motivates (i) a global guidance term to preserve the geometry of the final embedding space—critical for downstream tasks (classification, dense prediction, zero-shot transfer)—and (ii) token-level, depth-wise guidance to preserve intermediate computations and improve optimization stability. Therefore, we propose a multi-layer objective that is applied across selected depths of the two models during training.

blocks.en: We use cosine as our default alignment loss because it is scale-invariant and robust across teacher sizes and pre-training paradigms. Feature scales vary widely in practice; cosine normalizes this mismatch and directly optimizes angular agreement, which aligns well with objectives used during pre-training [ 80 , 72 ] . We also experimented with compatible objectives (MSE, SigLIP, InfoNCE) and found cosine to be the most stable across pre-trained teachers; ablations are reported in Sec. 5.2 . In contrast, MSE is sensitive to absolute scale, and contrastive variants (InfoNCE/SigLIP) introduce batch negatives that likely distort the teacher’s local geometry.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation and training setup
blocks.zh: 4.3 实施和培训

blocks.en: We now describe the implementation and training setup for feature alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们现在描述特征调整的实施和培训安排。

blocks.en: Datasets. We use the unlabeled, web-scale image sets CC3M [ 68 ] , CC12M [ 13 ] , and YFCC15M [ 22 ] for alignment. The input resolution follows the teacher’s default (typically 224 × 224 224{\times}224 ). For our main results ( Tab. 2 ), we report numbers for models trained on YFCC15M.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们使用无标签的网络比例图像集CC3M [68],CC12M [13],以及YFC15M [22]进行对齐. 输入分辨率跟随老师的默认值(典型的为224×224×224×times}224). 关于我们的主要结果(表2),我们报告接受YFCC15M培训的模型的数字。

blocks.en: Augmentations. We apply random resized crops and horizontal flips as augmentations to prevent overfitting while preserving 𝒯 \mathcal{T} – 𝒮 \mathcal{S} feature geometry during alignment.
blocks.zh: 增减相. 我们应用随机调整大小的收成和水平翻转作为增强来防止过度调整,同时在对齐时保留 T\ mathcal{T} – S\ mathcal{S} 特征几何.

blocks.en:
Optimization. We freeze 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and optimize 𝒮 \mathcal{S} with AdamW [ 45 ] and a cosine learning-rate schedule, with mixed precision enabled. We follow an early-stopping criterion to train until the loss on a held-out validation set stops decreasing; we fix B = 2 B{=}2 , keep additive biases at zero, and use no explicit weight normalization (cf. Sec. 3.2 ). Gradient norm clipping of 1.0 (with no weight decay) is used to stabilize large models. We sweep learning rates over 3e-3 , 1e-3 , and 5e-4 and select the model with the lowest alignment loss on the held-out split (a randomly sampled 30k subset of images from the training set). We use a batch size of 1024 for all experiments.
All unmarked results use checkpoints trained with the updated B-cos implementation and without the temporary weight-norm stabilization term that earlier checkpoints used to counter a potential training instability; † marks results from earlier checkpoints, including the ablations (see Sec. blocks.en: Train minimally, explain everywhere. Once aligned, the B-cos backbone is used as a drop-in encoder across tasks; explanations are model-inherent (derived from 𝐖 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) \mathbf{W}(\mathbf{x}) [ 8 ] ) and require no task-specific interpretability tuning.

blocks.en: Linear probing (LP). We evaluate the aligned representation quality of 𝒮 \mathcal{S} by training a linear head on frozen features, reporting top-1 accuracy on the validation sets of 10 downstream classification datasets (including IN1k) following the standard protocol [ 55 ] (see Sec. 5.1 ). To speed up evaluation, we do not apply augmentations during probing.
blocks.zh: 线性探测 (LP). 我们评价S\mathcal{S}的一致代表质量,方法是就被冻结的特征培训一个线性头,在标准协议[55](见Sec 5.1.)之后,报告10个下游分类数据集(包括IN1k)的验证组的顶一精确度。 为了加快评估,我们在探测时不采用增强措施。

blocks.en: k k -NN evaluation. To assess feature quality without additional training, we use a weighted k k -NN classifier on frozen embeddings. We pre-compute features on the training split and use k = 20 k{=}20 , a robust choice across datasets [ 12 ] and report accuracy (%) on the validation split(s).
blocks.zh: kk-NN评价。 在不增加培训的情况下评估特征质量时,我们在冷冻嵌入物上使用加权克-NN分类器。 我们预先计算关于训练分裂的特性,并使用 k = 20 k{=}20, 一个横跨数据集的有力选择 [12] , 并报告验证分裂的准确性(%)。

blocks.en: Zero-shot evaluation. For the contrastive vision–language setting (SigLIP2), we use the ALOE-aligned B-cos image encoder as a drop-in replacement while keeping the original text encoder unchanged. We use the 80 ImageNet prompt templates of [ 60 ] , averaging text embeddings per class; temperature and normalization follow the default settings. We evaluate zero-shot classification on standard benchmarks [ 60 , 80 ] and report accuracy (%).
blocks.zh: 零发评价. 对于对比的视觉-语言设置(SigLIP2),我们使用ALOE相通的 B-cos 图像编码器作为倒置替换,同时保持原始文本编码器不变. 我们使用[60]的80 ImageNet即时模板,平均每类嵌入文本;温度和常态遵循默认设置. 我们评价标准基准的零发分级[60,80]和报告准确性(%)。

blocks.en: Dense prediction. We evaluate dense prediction by training a linear depth head on frozen features and reporting NYUv2 [ 71 ] depth metrics.
blocks.zh: 紧张的预测。 我们通过对被冻结的地物进行线性深度头训练来评价密集的预测,并报告NYUv2[71]深度度量.

blocks.en: Evaluating explanations. We evaluate explanation quality using the Grid Pointing Game (GridPG) [ 6 , 81 ] for localization and pixel-deletion for faithfulness. For conventional models, we compare against several post-hoc methods (AttnLRP [ 1 ] , Integrated Gradients [ 73 ] , LeGrad [ 10 ] , CheferCAM [ 16 ] , and LIME [ 63 ] ); we also report results on a human preference study. Implementation details and additional results are provided in the appendix Sec. A and Sec. C.2 .
blocks.zh: 评估解释。 我们使用"Grid Pointing Game"(GridPG)[6,81]来评价解释质量,用于本地化和像素-删除来表示忠诚. 对于常规模型,我们比较了几种后热方法(AttnLRP[1],集成梯度[73],LeGrad[10],CeferCAM[16],和LIME[63]);我们还报告了人类偏好研究的结果. 附录Sec.A和Sec.C.2提供了执行细节和额外结果。

blocks.en: Multimodal LLMs. More broadly, our aligned SigLIP2 backbones can also serve as interpretable visual encoders within multimodal large language models (MLLMs). In preliminary experiments with a LLaVA-style Gemma-2-9B backbone [ 74 ] , they enable fine-grained visual grounding for individual generated tokens (see Fig. 8 ), suggesting that ALOE can extend beyond pure vision tasks. Since the current setup still relies on AttnLRP [ 1 ] to propagate relevance through the language model, we defer a fuller treatment of end-to-end inherently interpretable MLLMs to future work.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented ALOE (ALign Once to Explain), a simple yet effective framework that converts ViT-based foundational encoders into inherently interpretable B-cos variants. By preserving special tokens and aligning both global embeddings and token-level features at a few depths with a cosine objective, ALOE yields backbones that achieve competitive performance as compared to conventional foundation models across a diverse set of downstream tasks, provide faithful, well-localized explanations by design, and scale across pre-training paradigms and model sizes with modest amounts of unlabeled data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了ALOE(ALign Once to Explain),这是一个简单而有效的框架,将基于ViT的基础编码器转换为内在可解释的B-cos变体. ALOE保留了特殊标志,并在几处深度将全球嵌入物和符号级特征与同心目标相配合,因此,与传统基础模型相比,在一系列不同的下游任务中,ALOE产生能够实现竞争性业绩的骨干,通过设计提供忠实、本地化的解释,并在培训前范式和模型大小之间作分寸,同时提供少量无标签数据。

blocks.en: Compared to B-cosification [ 4 ] , ALOE removes the need for supervised fine-tuning, addresses the ViT performance gap, and preserves contrastive zero-shot utility—offering a resource-efficient path to interpretable backbones at foundation scale. We show empirically that our proposed recipe can already recover most of the teacher’s generalization from a small unlabeled alignment set, even with only 150k images in the SigLIP2 data-scaling ablation. Taken together, ALOE offers a practical path to scalable, trustworthy vision backbones: align once, reuse broadly, and amortize the cost of interpretability.
blocks.zh: 比起B码 [4],ALOE取消了监督微调的需要,解决了VIT性能差距,并保留了对比性的"零射"效用——为基础尺度的可解释主干道献出资源效率高的路径. 我们的经验证明,我们提议的食谱已经能够从一个小的无标签的对齐集中恢复大部分老师的概括性,即使SigLIP2数据缩放中只有150克的图像。 综合起来,ALOE为可伸缩的,可信赖的视觉主干线提供了一条实用的道路:一次对齐,广泛再用,并摊还可解释性的成本.

blocks.en: Localization (GridPG). ALOE aligned models yield substantial improvements in GridPG localization across pre-training paradigms and backbones while maintaining competitive performance in both recognition and dense prediction tasks. Compared to conventional teacher models explained with post-hoc attribution methods (AttnLRP [ 1 ] , Integrated Gradients [ 73 ] , LeGrad [ 10 ] , and CheferCAM [ 16 ] ), inherently interpretable B-cos explanations from ALOE achieve consistently higher localization scores. The gains are substantial across SigLIP2, DINOv3, and supervised ViT backbones, with Δ GridPG \Delta_{\text{GridPG}} ranging from +18.71 to +36.09 , showing that aligned B-cos models provide more localized, class-specific attributions without sacrificing downstream accuracy.

This works especially well for CheferCAM, LeGrad, and IntGrad, while AttnLRP improves less because it already achieves relatively high scores on the standard teacher. blocks.en: Human user study. We also performed a human user study in which the subjective preferences of different attribution methods for DINOv3 ViT-B/16 were evaluated. 41 users on Amazon Mechanical Turk performed 50 trials, each consisting of a random image with 2 attribution maps from randomly drawn attribution methods (AttnLRP, IntGrad, Chefer, LeGrad, LIME, B-cos). An example for one trial is shown in Fig. C5 . The predicted class of the image was provided, and the user had to choose the explanation that best helped them understand the model’s prediction. We fitted a Bradley–Terry (BT) model [ 11 ] to the outcome of the study in order to derive the pairwise win-probabilities between attribution methods. BT is similar to logistic regression on the one-hot encoded study data, where the winning class receives the score + 1 +1 and the negative − 1 -1 (with 1 1 as the target value). The derived BT weights indicate the overall performance relative to the other models. By computing the sigmoid of the difference β 1 − β 2 \beta_{1}-\beta_{2} between the weights of two attribution methods, we can derive the probability of method 1 1 winning against method 2 2 . The probabilities, together with the BT-scores, are shown in Tab. C7 . ALOE is preferred over all post-hoc baselines ( > 50 % >50\% win rate) while being the most compute-efficient method.

blocks.en: Comparisons with popular attribution methods. Figures D2 , D3 and D4 contrast ALOE (ours) —which uses model-inherent B-cos attributions 𝐖 ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) ​ 𝐱 \mathbf{W}(\mathbf{x})\mathbf{x} —with AttnLRP, Integrated Gradients, LeGrad, CheferCAM, and LIME. Across diverse categories, ALOE produces more object-centric explanations with sharper boundaries and less background noise. The six-channel encoding preserves color semantics, yielding explanations that align with class-specific parts and textures. These trends also mirror our quantitative gains in GridPG and pixel-perturbation stability ( Tabs. C6 and C3 ). All examples for this use DINOv3-based backbones (ViT-B/16) with linear probes trained on ImageNet-1k.

blocks.en: Multimodal large language model explanations. In addition to the explanations in Fig. 8 , we provide further examples—including failure cases—in Figs. D6 , D7 and D8 . Using AttnLRP [ 1 ] , we propagate relevance through the LLaVA-MORE [ 21 ] Gemma-2-9B [ 74 ] backbone, utilizing B-cos inherent explanations from the ALOE SigLIP2 vision encoder. Notably, Fig. D7 and Fig. D8 demonstrate instances where explanations fail to match predictions. We suspect that this discrepancy likely stems from three factors: the model relying on spurious associations, reliance on previous tokens restricting the vision-to-language information flow, or AttnLRP fundamentally generating unfaithful explanations. As we discussed earlier, since the current setup still relies on AttnLRP to propagate relevance through the language model, we defer a fuller treatment of end-to-end inherently interpretable MLLMs to future work.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型解释. 除了图8中的解释外,我们还提供了其他例子,包括图中的失败案例。 D6, D7 和 D8 数字 我们使用AttnLRP [1],通过LLAVA-MORE [21] Gemma-2-9B [74] 骨干传播相关性,利用了ALOE SigLIP2视觉编码器中B-cos的固有解释. 值得注意的是,图D7和图D8显示了解释与预测不一致的情况。 我们怀疑这种差异可能来自三个因素:依赖虚假关联的模式,依赖以前限制视觉到语言信息流动的标志,或AttnLRP从根本上产生不诚实的解释. 正如我们先前所讨论的那样,由于目前的设置仍然依赖AttnLRP通过语言模式传播相关性,我们把对端到端内在可解释的MLLMs的更充分的处理推迟到今后的工作.
